niche: a statewide hospital alliance's ICU surge compact, whose regional trigger counts full adult-ICU hospital-days that three conflicting capacity feeds (a 07:00 census survey, a transfer-status board, a transfer center's declines) each record imperfectly
answer: Activate the Ridgeline ICU Surge Compact in Northeast, Upper Cumberland, South Central and West at the 20 January 2026 review: estimated shares of full adult ICU hospital-days 50, 50, 70 and 80 per cent against one in three, East, Southeast, Mid-State and Memphis Delta at 20, 10, 10 and 10.
stakeholder_role: the alliance's surge compact operations committee

spine.entity: one status change of one hospital unit on the regional bed-status board
spine.grain: hospital unit by status change (UTC timestamp)
spine.source: synthetic (constructed in the layout of a regional bed-status board's event export)

world.geography: United States: Tennessee (eight surge regions of a statewide hospital alliance across the Eastern and Central time zones; the alliance, its hospitals, feeds and people are fictional, counties real)
world.org_type: a statewide hospital alliance running an ICU surge compact among its member hospitals

driver: The decisive quantity is how often a state held in each group of units, seen only through three independent records that each miss some instances and flag some non-instances, one catching nearly every instance but also a third of non-instances and two rarely flagging a non-instance but missing most instances, so every rule that settles each unit from its records either keeps the first record's false flags or drops most instances, and only a latent class model of the three records, their miss and false-flag rates estimated from how they agree and the state's frequency free in each group, counts the instances.
driver_concrete: The compact activates a region for the four weeks from 26 January 2026 when at least one in three of its adult-ICU hospital-days in the 28 days to 18 January were full; the bed-status board shows Closed on about 93 per cent of full days but also on about a third of ordinary days (hospitals close to transfers to keep their last beds), while the 07:00 census survey and the transfer center's no-bed declines rarely flag an ordinary day but catch under a third of full days, so counting a day full when any feed shows it activates all eight regions, requiring two feeds activates none or one, and only the latent class estimate of each region's share of full days activates the four regions where it is one in three or more.
stump: A competent analyst conforms the three feeds to hospital-days, counts a day full when any feed shows it full (the compact's 'at some time during the day') and activates all eight regions instead of four; the step that lands it there is settling each hospital-day from the feeds' flags instead of estimating each region's share of full days from a latent class model of how often each feed misses a full day or flags an ordinary one.
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms every feed correctly and reads the full-day definition literally counts a day full when any feed shows it and activates all eight regions (requiring two feeds to agree, none); no rule that settles each hospital-day from its flags, the corroborated board or the model's own most likely class included, names the four regions the latent class estimate activates.
domain_test: In general statistics the swap is of the method: the deciding quantity is each region's share of full hospital-days estimated by a latent class model of three conflicting feeds (the Fellegi-Sunter machinery of record linkage: agreement patterns, per-source miss and false-flag rates, no reference source), and replacing it with any record-level reconciliation rule (any feed, two of three, corroboration, the model's own most likely class) changes which regions activate.

differentiation.task180: task180 counts events one detector records only above a daily noise cycle and recovers the masked share from its quiet hours; here no single record is the detector: three independent feeds each miss full days and flag ordinary ones, and each region's share is estimated from their joint agreement by a latent class model
differentiation.task255: task255 fits a size distribution carrying per-item truncation and censoring; here the counted state is binary, seen through three conflicting categorical feeds, and the count is a latent class prevalence by region
differentiation.task228: task228 separates continuous random errors of three collocated series by their covariances and its stump is a shared input; here the feeds are categorical with both error directions, no feed is the reference, and the stump is the record-level reconciliation rule an ETL pipeline applies
differentiation.task253: task253 counts units below a line by summing probabilities from a hierarchical model of noisy averages; here the decisive step is the measurement model of three conflicting feeds (their miss and false-flag rates identified by three-way agreement), and every record-level rule, simple or weighted, misses the set
differentiation.task446: task446 carries a screen's two error rates onto a population whose base rate moved, rates known from past outcomes; here no outcome is ever observed and the feeds' error rates are estimated from their agreement alone
differentiation.task452: task452 corrects a map's area with a stratified reference sample that observes the truth; here nothing observes the truth and the latent class model identifies the feeds' errors without a reference
differentiation.task454: task454 fills the acquisition cost of the claims that fail to link to a priced code, imputed within product and package type from the claims that do link; here every record links to its hospital, no record is the truth, and each feed's miss and false-flag rates are estimated from the three feeds' agreement, each region's share being the latent prevalence

notes: Seed ET13 (analytical_tasks/07_data_extraction_conformation): the world, decision and quantity kept (a hospital association's regional surge compact, activated region by region from hospital capacity reporting); its decoy-era traps (average of ratios, suppression sentinels, the wrong ICU) are not used. The pairing moves to General Statistics & Data Science / data integration (record linkage): hospital operations' own analytical pitfalls (demand capped at capacity, blocking probability) live in task types serving forecasting and opportunity sizing, and the ETL decision here turns on combining conflicting sources. Strategy other: a measurement model (two-class latent class model with conditional independence, common error rates statewide, prevalence by region). Gap population (a flagged hospital-day is not a full hospital-day).
layer1: three feeds for one picture, each with its own key, grain and clock: a daily census survey keyed by state licence number, a bed-status board's event log keyed by its own facility code with UTC timestamps, a transfer center's call log keyed by hospital names as typed
two time zones: East Tennessee hospitals keep Eastern time, the rest and the transfer center Central time, so each feed's timestamps fall on the hospital's own local date only after conversion
survey reports resubmitted after correction, the later submission superseding; a column renamed when the survey form changed
board lines for every unit (adult ICUs under several labels, pediatric and neonatal ICUs, emergency departments, medical-surgical floors), statuses carried over from before the window
transfer requests reopened under the same request number, cancelled requests, decline reasons recoded when the center's code list changed
a facility crosswalk and a name-alias list that map licence numbers, board codes and typed names onto one hospital and its region
holiday gaps in the census survey on 25 December and 1 January
